source_completeness.source_accuracy_boundary: Readable structural coverage is not proof of correct SQL. Source inconsistencies are itemized in the source map.

known_limitations: Only the uploaded second edition was used. No external errata or current database documentation was consulted.
All 164 recipes are represented as reasoning patterns, not executable reproductions. They have not been run on DB2, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.

Object reference candidates are lexically detected and not a complete verified schema. CTEs, views, helpers, and physical sample tables must be distinguished.
No company schema, platform integration, business metric formula, causal model, live query plan, or production result is supplied.
